description: Find the best meeting times across time zones: give 2-20 IANA zones (optionally with per-person hours like Asia/Tokyo@08:00-18:00) and a date; returns the windows where everyone is inside working hours, the top-ranked slots (everyone in hours first, then fewest people outside, then least early / late), each with every participant's local time and weekday, plus UTC offsets. DST-correct, weekends flagged. Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/meeting-planner

date.description: Meeting date in the first zone (default today)

includeWeekends.description: Count Saturday / Sunday as working days

zones.description: IANA zones, each optionally "@HH:MM-HH:MM" working hours
